narrative.northStar: Graphite, cool paper and working commands
narrative.overview: A technical, austere world uses system typography, ruled sections and commands as its material. The official fab teal is the functional signal in both light and dark modes. User-supplied SVG wordmarks define the identity. Hallmark Cobalt remains composition and control ancestry; the explicit official brand takes precedence.
keyCharacteristics: System fonts with a distinct monospace command voice.
Flat, bordered surfaces and restrained official teal emphasis.
Working controls with visible keyboard focus and truthful state feedback.

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Use teal to identify action, focus or a meaningful relationship. The user-requested official mark motif is a restrained brand exception.

rules.name: The Local Type Rule
rules.body: Use installed system fonts; load no external font resources.

dos: Do preserve paired foreground and background roles in both modes.
Do keep keyboard focus, readable command wrapping and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use real commands and explicit availability labels.
Do preserve official SVG geometry, colors and mode variants.
donts: Don't load external fonts or visual resources.
Don't invent product output, adoption evidence or testimonials.
Don't extend the copy button’s narrow key edge to cards or section containers.
